proposals.evidence: LSI avu poyu “They will beat” contains a separate pronoun and inflected verb. DEDR 1 records Kodagu avu/aeŋga in the distal third-person family. DEDR 4534 quotes Kodagu poyy (poyyuv-, pojj-) “beat”; LSI present/future poy- and past pojj- belong to this paradigm. DEDR 4407 has a homophonous Kodagu poyy- “rain”; the survey’s transitive “beat” gloss selects 4534. Ordered links preserve the source word boundary and do not treat the sentence as a single inherited stem.
